acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-core -- validate_message_id passes; 3 new tests green; 0 regressions
description:
What: Extend validate_message_id in crates/core/src/validation.rs to reject all bytes below 0x20 (not just whitespace/NUL) and DEL (0x7F). UUCP-G2.
File: crates/core/src/validation.rs
Algorithm:
1. Find the forbidden closure in is_valid_message_id (around line 89).
2. Current: let forbidden = |c: char| c.is_whitespace() || c == '<' || c == '>' || c == '\0';
3. Replace with: let forbidden = |c: char| (c as u32) < 0x20 || c == '<' || c == '>' || c as u32 == 0x7f;
   Rationale: RFC 5322 §2.2 requires printable US-ASCII (0x21–0x7E) in header token values. 0x20 (space) is already handled: the RFC 5321 atext grammar does not allow spaces in Message-IDs, and the angle-bracket wrapper is separately stripped. 0x7F (DEL) is non-printable and should also be forbidden.
4. Verify existing tests for is_valid_message_id still pass (regression).
Defensive rules: Change ONLY the forbidden closure — do not refactor surrounding code. Add tests only in the existing test module.
Tests (add to existing #[cfg(test)] mod tests in validation.rs):
- validate_message_id_rejects_0x01: input "<\x01@example.com>"; assert Err
- validate_message_id_rejects_0x1f: input "<test\x1f@example.com>"; assert Err
- validate_message_id_rejects_del: input "<test\x7f@example.com>"; assert Err
- validate_message_id_still_rejects_nul: regression for existing case
- validate_message_id_still_rejects_whitespace: regression for existing case
title: Fix validate_message_id: reject control chars < 0x20
